summary: Docker image scanning detects two PyO3 security vulnerabilities (out-of-bounds read and missing Sync bound) in version 0.25.1. Fixed by upgrading to PyO3 0.29.0.
userImpact: Users' Docker images fail security scans due to unpatched PyO3 vulnerabilities until the SDK is upgraded.
rootCause: PyO3 0.25.1 contains unpatched CVEs (GHSA-36hh-v3qg-5jq4 and GHSA-chgr-c6px-7xpp) fixed in version 0.29.0.
proposedFix: Upgrade PyO3 from 0.25.1 to 0.29.0 in Cargo.lock.
resolutionDetails: Fixed in PR #1599 by upgrading PyO3 to version 0.29.0.
keyQuote: The version 0.29.0 of pyo3 solves these security issues.
